```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(agricolae)
library(emmeans)
library(DescTools)
library(pwr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r data}
# Read data from CSV
data <- read.csv("results.csv")

# Convert to factors with readable labels
data$stack_algorithm <- factor(data$stack_algorithm, 
                                levels = c("dig_out", "a_star"),
                                labels = c("Dig-Out", "BFS"))
data$ground_algorithm <- factor(data$ground_algorithm,
                                 levels = c("greedy", "patient"),
                                 labels = c("Greedy", "Patient"))
data$corruption_rate <- factor(data$corruption_rate,
                               levels = c(0.05, 0.1),
                               labels = c("5%", "10%"))

# Rename for clarity in analysis
data$stack <- data$stack_algorithm
data$ground <- data$ground_algorithm
data$corruption <- data$corruption_rate
data$value <- data$total_moves

str(data)
head(data)

# Main effect: Stack Algorithm
ggplot(data, aes(x = stack, y = value)) + 
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Main Effect of Stack Algorithm", 
       y = "Mean Total Moves", 
       x = "Stack Algorithm") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Main effect: Ground Algorithm
ggplot(data, aes(x = ground, y = value)) + 
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Main Effect of Ground Algorithm", 
       y = "Mean Total Moves", 
       x = "Ground Algorithm") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Main effect: Corruption Rate
ggplot(data, aes(x = corruption, y = value)) + 
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Main Effect of Corruption Rate", 
       y = "Mean Total Moves", 
       x = "Corruption Rate") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Calculate group means for interaction plots
group_means <- data %>%
  group_by(stack, ground, corruption) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print(group_means)

# Two-way interaction plots
# 1. Stack x Corruption
group_means_sc <- data %>%
  group_by(stack, corruption) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(group_means_sc, aes(x = corruption, y = mean_value, color = stack, group = stack)) + 
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se), width = 0.15) +
  labs(title = "Interaction: Stack Algorithm x Corruption Rate", 
       y = "Mean Total Moves", 
       x = "Corruption Rate", 
       color = "Stack Algorithm") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# 2. Ground x Corruption
group_means_gc <- data %>%
  group_by(ground, corruption) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(group_means_gc, aes(x = corruption, y = mean_value, color = ground, group = ground)) + 
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se), width = 0.15) +
  labs(title = "Interaction: Ground Algorithm x Corruption Rate", 
       y = "Mean Total Moves", 
       x = "Corruption Rate", 
       color = "Ground Algorithm") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# 3. Stack x Ground
group_means_sg <- data %>%
  group_by(stack, ground) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

ggplot(group_means_sg, aes(x = ground, y = mean_value, color = stack, group = stack)) + 
  geom_line(size = 1) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se), width = 0.15) +
  labs(title = "Interaction: Stack Algorithm x Ground Algorithm", 
       y = "Mean Total Moves", 
       x = "Ground Algorithm", 
       color = "Stack Algorithm") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
```

```{r analysis}
# Three-way interaction plot (Stack x Ground faceted by Corruption)
ggplot(group_means, aes(x = ground, y = mean_value, color = stack, group = stack)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se, ymax = mean_value + se), width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~corruption) +
  labs(
    title = "Three-Way Interaction: Stack x Ground x Corruption",
    x = "Ground Algorithm",
    y = "Mean Total Moves",
    color = "Stack Algorithm"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Fit three-way ANOVA model with all interactions
# Model: Total Moves ~ Stack * Ground * Corruption
model <- aov(value ~ stack * ground * corruption, data = data)

# Display ANOVA table with significance tests
summary(model)

# Store results and create effects plot
anova_sum <- summary(model)[[1]]
plot.design(value ~ stack + ground + corruption, data = data)

# Calculate Observed Effect Size from Data
k <- 8  # Number of groups (2 stack x 2 ground x 2 corruption)
n_per_group <- nrow(data) / k # samples per group

# Calculate eta-squared (eta^2) from ANOVA
ss_total <- sum((data$value - mean(data$value))^2)
ss_residual <- sum(residuals(model)^2)
ss_treatment <- ss_total - ss_residual
eta_squared <- ss_treatment / ss_total

# Convert eta-squared to Cohen's f
# f = sqrt(eta^2 / (1 - eta^2))
f_observed <- sqrt(eta_squared / (1 - eta_squared))

cat("Observed Effect Size:\n")
cat("  Eta-squared (eta^2):", round(eta_squared, 4), "\n")
cat("  Cohen's f:", round(f_observed, 4), "\n")

# Sample Size Calculation (using observed effect size)
pwr_result <- pwr.anova.test(k = k, f = f_observed, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.9)
cat("\nRequired sample size per group (at observed effect):", ceiling(pwr_result$n), "\n")

# Calculate actual power achieved
actual_power <- pwr.anova.test(k = k, n = n_per_group, f = f_observed, sig.level = 0.05)$power
cat("Actual power achieved:", round(actual_power, 4), "\n")

# Tukey's HSD Test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(model)
print(tukey_result)
plot(tukey_result, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.6)

# Estimated Marginal Means (EMMs) - Proper contrasts respecting interactions
cat("\n=== Estimated Marginal Means Analysis ===\n\n")

# Main effects
emm_stack <- emmeans(model, ~ stack)
emm_ground <- emmeans(model, ~ ground)
emm_corruption <- emmeans(model, ~ corruption)

cat("Main Effect: Stack Algorithm\n")
print(emm_stack)
print(pairs(emm_stack))

cat("\nMain Effect: Ground Algorithm\n")
print(emm_ground)
print(pairs(emm_ground))

cat("\nMain Effect: Corruption Rate\n")
print(emm_corruption)
print(pairs(emm_corruption))

# Two-way interactions
cat("\n=== Two-Way Interactions ===\n")
emm_stack_ground <- emmeans(model, ~ stack | ground)
cat("\nStack x Ground Interaction:\n")
print(emm_stack_ground)
print(pairs(emm_stack_ground))

emm_stack_corruption <- emmeans(model, ~ stack | corruption)
cat("\nStack x Corruption Interaction:\n")
print(emm_stack_corruption)
print(pairs(emm_stack_corruption))

# Three-way interaction
emm_three_way <- emmeans(model, ~ stack * ground * corruption)
cat("\nThree-Way Interaction (All 8 Conditions):\n")
print(emm_three_way)

# Assumption Tests
## Residuals vs Fitted
plot(model, which=1)
## Q-Q Residuals
plot(model, which=2)
```
